neighbours.label: the token right after a writer's or reader's reference to this very text (as I write this, as you read this, if you are reading this as, I wrote this post while): the frame of the act of writing or reading, as opposed to the same clause about some other action or document
fire: Even now, as I type these words, the kids are asleep upstairs.
If you are reading this as a new parent, take a deep breath.
Right now, as you read this, the polls are already open in the east.
I wrote this column while sitting in a hospital waiting room.
Honestly, as I write this, I still have not decided what to do.
If you are reading this post as a beginner, start with the basics.
Somewhere, as you read this, a farmer is starting the morning harvest.
I drafted this entry while the power was out across town.
quiet: Even now, as I fold the laundry, the kids are asleep upstairs.
If you are holding a new baby, take a deep breath.
Right now, as the sun rises, the polls are already open in the east.
I knitted the scarf while sitting in a hospital waiting room.
Honestly, as I drove home, I still had not decided what to do.
If you are taking the course as a beginner, start with the basics.
Somewhere, as the bells ring, a farmer is starting the morning harvest.
I cooked the soup while the power was out across town.
